_doc: Standings sources for the daily scorer. The job fetches the live group tables (Pts/GD/GF etc.) from these, normalizes team names via teams.json, and reconciles by consensus. IMPORTANT: trust the RAW NUMBERS, not any site's displayed rank — 2026 tiebreaker descriptions conflict across sites. Mid-group: we order pts->GD->GF ourselves. Group complete: take the agreed final order via consensus.

consensus.rule: For each group, accept a team's raw stat line only if at least `min_agreement` INDEPENDENT sources agree on it. Prefer simple majority when more than 2 independent sources return data. If agreement can't be reached for a group, mark it 'disputed' and skip scoring that group rather than score off a bad number.
consensus.independence_note: Only count ONE source per independence_group toward agreement. Sources sharing a group (e.g. a shared data vendor, or a Wikipedia copy of FIFA) are not independent votes.

sources.name: FOX Sports
sources.notes: Best plain-HTML scrape found; all 12 groups A-L in the page HTML. Displayed tiebreaker order is the OLD one (group GD first) — ignore its rank, use raw numbers.

sources.name: FIFA official
sources.notes: Authoritative source of truth, but JS/API-backed — needs a rendered fetch or underlying JSON discovery, not a plain GET. Once a group is COMPLETE, this is the canonical final order.

sources.name: ESPN
sources.notes: Independent broadcaster source; JS/app-heavy, may need rendered DOM or embedded app JSON. Stable league slug 'fifa.world'. CHECK whether its data vendor overlaps with FOX — if so, collapse them into one independence_group.

sources.name: Wikipedia
sources.update: minutes to hours; can lag or be vandalized
sources.notes: Easiest plain-HTML source with all columns, but downstream of FIFA + human-edited — NOT an independent vote (same independence_group as fifa). Use as a sanity/audit fallback, not a core voter.

sources.name: Sofascore
sources.notes: Independent live-data provider; JS/app page, likely needs its internal API. Good extra independent voter if scrapeable — verify access before relying on it.

sources.name: Soccerway
sources.notes: Perform Group data provider; real-time standings. JS-ish page. Another independent voter to round out the pool.

excluded.reason: Terms text disallows systematic/regular robot use — avoid for an automated daily job.
No stable public URL/API for scraping; opaque underlying provider.
Could not verify a scrapeable 2026 group-table endpoint; revisit if a stable URL is confirmed.
